title: 第19章 你没死第20章 表情凶巴巴的苏灿
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
姜玉容和杨雅丽在听萧老首长叫战东这个名字时，差点双腿一软昏过去。
她们怎么都没想到，萧老首长口里一直说的那个所谓的副师长，竟然就是她们一心想悔婚的陆战东。
如果说开始的时候还有些疑惑，可是后面听著老首长和方局的对话，她们已经百分百確定里面的那个人就是陆战东了。
那时候以为他就是个双腿残废的军人，谁能想到他的腿不仅能治，而且还要提拔为副师长。
这可怎么办？
杨雅丽像被人直接泼了一盆冷水，从天堂直接跌到了地狱里。
现在苏灿已经代替她嫁给陆战东了，那自己这泼天的富贵不是白白送给苏灿了吗？
姜玉容其实心里也很慌，不过她稍稍一想便又稳住了。
趁著前面的两人谈话时，她在女儿耳边叮嘱了几句：“苏灿是自己偷偷跑过去的，跟我们家可没有关係。你只要好好表现就行了。”
这话顿时让杨雅丽看到了希望，慌乱的心又慢慢稳住了。
对呀，说苏灿嫁给了陆战东，证据呢？
她可是个死胖子，又丑又黑还一身的皮肤病，就算是那个女人来了，老首长也不可能看上她。
有母亲在身边，杨雅丽顿时像吃了好几颗定心丸。
萧老首长听著方局长的话有些诧异看向走过来的母女俩。
“小方，这女孩子是我准备介绍给战东的对象，你怎么说她是战东的未婚妻呢？”
方局长被问的一愣，还没来得及回答，姜玉容便笑著向萧老首长鞠躬道歉：“老首长，这事我得先向您道个歉。其实我们家雅丽这段时间也一直在找战东，但是怎么也找不到他的半点消息。我並不知道战东是您的老部下，听秀姐说对方是个军人，腿还受了伤，就想借著这个机会来看看。
起初我们不敢跟您说实话，因为这两个多月以来，我们四处打听情况，都没有他的半点消息。我们一直以为他犯了什么政治性错误，所以才找地方藏了起来。战东和雅丽的婚事还是方局长牵的线，您要是不信可以问问他。”
对於苏灿代替杨雅丽这个妹妹嫁到桃村的事，方局长並不知晓。
听完姜玉容的话，方局长笑了起来：“老首长，这事我向您证明。这桩婚事確实是我牵的线，两个人之前处的也不错。前段时间她们確实找过我，那时候我也不知道战东人在哪。今天这事您也別怪她们，別说她们是普通老百姓，就是我们不也没找到战东吗？”
萧老首长爽朗一笑：“也难怪人家会想出这样的办法来，还不都是怪战东那个臭小子，谁找都找不到。我都以为他牺牲了。”

因为陆战东是在战场上离开的，那场战爭大获全胜，他立了大功。
可是找他的时候，却怎么也没找到人。
所有人都以为他很可能牺牲了，要知道边境上还有一些流窜的境外势力，万一遇上了肯定是一场拼杀。
可谁都没想到，他竟然回了自己的老家。
“哈哈，我看这误会不错。说明雅丽和战东是真的有缘分。”
方局长对於自己牵的媒更加满意。
萧老首长笑著点点头，看著他抬了下手：“咱们也了解的差不多了，开门吧。”
content_en:
Jiang Yurong and Yang Yali almost fainted when they heard Chief Xiao call Zhan Dong by their name.
They never expected that the so-called deputy division commander that Mr. Xiao kept talking about was actually Lu Zhandong, whom they wanted to regret their marriage.
If there were still some doubts at the beginning, after listening to the conversation between the old chief and Fang Bureau, they were 100% sure that the person inside was Lu Zhandong.
At that time, I thought he was just a soldier with disabled legs. Who would have thought that not only could his legs be cured, but he would also be promoted to deputy division commander.
What can we do?
Yang Yali felt as if someone poured cold water on her, and she fell directly from heaven to hell.
Now that Su Can has married Lu Zhandong on her behalf, didn't he give his incredible wealth to Su Can in vain?
Jiang Yurong was actually panicking, but she regained her composure after thinking about it for a moment.
While the two people in front were talking, she whispered a few words in her daughter's ear: "Su Can ran over secretly on his own and has nothing to do with our family. You just need to behave well."
These words immediately gave Yang Yali hope, and her panicked heart gradually stabilized.
Yes, it is said that Su Can married Lu Zhandong, where is the evidence?
She is a fat person, ugly, dark and has skin diseases. Even if that woman comes, the old chief will not be able to like her.
With her mother by her side, Yang Yali suddenly felt like she had taken several reassurances.
Chief Xiao was a little surprised when he heard Director Fang's words and looked at the mother and daughter walking over.
"Xiao Fang, this girl is the one I plan to introduce to Zhan Dong. How do you say she is Zhan Dong's fiancée?"
Director Fang was stunned by the question. Before he could answer, Jiang Yurong smiled and bowed to Chief Xiao and apologized: "Old Chief, I have to apologize to you first. In fact, our Yali has been looking for Zhan Dong during this period, but she can't find any news about him. I didn't know that Zhan Dong was your old subordinate. I heard Sister Xiu said that he was a soldier and his leg was injured, so I wanted to take this opportunity to take a look.
At first we didn't dare to tell you the truth, because for more than two months, we have been asking around and there is no news about him. We always thought he had made some political mistake, so we found a place to hide him. Director Fang was still involved in Zhan Dong and Yali's marriage. If you don't believe it, you can ask him. "
Director Fang did not know that Su Can had married Yang Yali to Taocun instead of his younger sister.
After listening to Jiang Yurong's words, Director Fang laughed: "Old chief, let me prove this to you. I am indeed the one behind this marriage, and the two of us were getting along well before. They did come looking for me some time ago, and I didn't know where Zhan Dong was at that time. Don't blame them for today's matter. Not to mention that they are ordinary people, didn't we find Zhan Dong?"
Chief Xiao smiled heartily: "It's no wonder people came up with such a method. It's not all the fault of that brat Zhan Dong. No one can find him. I thought he was sacrificed."
Because Lu Zhandong left on the battlefield, the war was a complete victory and he made great contributions.
But when I looked for him, I couldn't find him.
Everyone thought that he might have died. You must know that there are some foreign forces roaming around the border. If they encounter them, it will definitely be a fight.
But no one expected that he would return to his hometown.
"Haha, I think this is a good misunderstanding. It shows that Yali and Zhan Dong are really destined."
Director Fang is even more satisfied with the matchmaker he has managed.
Chief Xiao smiled and nodded, looked at him and raised his hand: "We understand it almost. Let's open the door."
